_about: Birth dates for the 'Emerging' label and the emerging picks only (the top-10 ranking never uses age). Covers every signable player ranked above average under pressure (the pool the top 10 is drawn from) and every signable player under 26 with 25+ pressure balls (the pool the emerging picks are drawn from, including the young names who dip under pressure). Full dates are given for players born near or after the cutoff (1 April 2001: under 26 at the start of IPL 2027, the IPL Emerging Player age test) and were checked against public profiles (Wikipedia, ICC, Wisden, ESPNcricinfo, cricket.com.au, Cricket Ireland). A year alone is given where the player is clearly older than the cutoff.
